issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify that Milkable.messageOnMilk() should return a String, but the solution repository defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() with return type boolean and the Seal and Goat implementations print a message and return true. This mismatch will confuse students about the correct method signature and prevents straightforward implementation of the expected behavior (returning the milk message as a String).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem specification: change Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return String (not boolean), and update Seal and Goat to return the milk message string (e.g. "Seal Clarabelle is milked") instead of printing and returning a boolean. Alternatively, if the boolean design is intentional, update the problem statement/UML and template Main usage to expect a boolean return and adjust examples accordingly. The preferred fix is to make Milkable.messageOnMilk(): String and have implementations return the descriptive string.
